# The Main Quest

The Main Quest is a gamified life command center operated by adam.inc. The public site explains how a long-range life vision becomes one day-scoped next quest with a clear goal, immediate feedback, a bounded stopwatch, and a control that can shrink an overwhelming action.

## Public pages

- Home: https://themain.quest/
- Free public Board demo: https://themain.quest/board
- About: https://themain.quest/about
- Contact: https://themain.quest/contact
- Privacy: https://themain.quest/privacy

## Access boundary

The public Board is free to try and stores demonstration state in the visitor's browser. The Life and Money OS routes are private owner tools protected by an approved Google identity. Public HTML and client bundles must not include raw vault notes, private finances, calendar events, or complete task data.
